description: Create or edit a character style without applying it (Character Style Options): name, Based On, Reset To Base, and its font, size, leading, tracking, case, position, scale, colour and stroke attributes

applyToSelection.description: Apply Style to Selection: also apply the style to the selected text

attributes.description: Character attributes to set, by InDesign property name

fillColor.description: Character colour: a swatch name or #RRGGBB (A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch))

fillTint.description: Character colour tint in percent (-1 = none)

fontStyle.description: Font style name, such as Bold or Italic

strokeColor.description: Character stroke colour: a swatch name or #RRGGBB (A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch))

tracking.description: Tracking in thousandths of an em

basedOn.description: Based On: the parent character style: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

create.description: Create the style when it does not exist yet

group.description: Style group path for a new style, such as "Headings" or "Body/Lists" (groups are created as needed). Without it, a "Group/Style" name puts the style in that group

resetToBase.description: Reset To Base: make the style match its Based On style before applying attributes

style.description: The character style to edit (or to create, with create: true): a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

name: set_character_style
title: Set Character Style
